q: Can other members see my rating?
a: No. Only Boomer and the admins see ratings and comments. Your own page shows yours.

q: Why does Not for me need a comment?
a: A thumbs down with no reason can't be fixed. One sentence is plenty.
Features, pages, Arcade games and stream setup that are live and open to you. Vault games and streams don't count toward Full Coverage; Vault games have their own Vault Critic badges.

q: Do I get XP for rating?
a: Not per rating. The badges pay XP, and Night Shift runs rating activities some weeks.
